answer: Sybil resistance follows from a reputation score with an exponential temporal half-life: each identity must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned node, whether labeled raven, oasis, or lagoon, starts with near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity further discounts isolated collusion, preventing such identities from accumulating consensus weight quickly.
